newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision Q1 net per share loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision Q1 net per share loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Full name of company is Cablevision Systems Corp.
Net figures listed above were net losses applicable to common shareholders, after preferred dividend requirements.

Results do not reflect transactions announced during the first quarter, including the planned purchase from ITT Corp of the 50 percent of Madison Square Garden and the New York Knicks and Rangers professional sports teams that Cablevision did not own already.
As of March 31, company served about 2.5 million subscribers, up one percent during the first quarter. Recurring average monthly revenue per subscriber was $37.45.
